title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 30 ]

items.text: Not to pretend to know is good.
It is not easy to know oneself.
It takes one hour for me to get here. (It takes me one hour to get here.)
It was difficult for him to keep up with his classmates.
It is not easy for me to make myself understood in English.
It is difficult for me to answer that question.
It is rude of you to do so.
It is very kind of you to help me.
It is too bad of him to desert his old father.
It is foolish of you to believe him.
It is very wise of him to study English grammar first.
It's so thoughtful of you to prepare dinner for us tonight.
My rule is to get up early.
The company's goal is to control 90% of auto sales.
I make it a rule to get up early.
